name: frontend hexagonal
authoritative_sources: UI, state and API boundary tests
rules: Separate presentation, state, API adapters and domain-facing data from external transport details.
Keep UI behavior driven by explicit models and states rather than provider or backend implementation leakage.
Represent loading, incomplete, failed and degraded states explicitly where relevant.
verification: Inspect frontend dependency direction and adapter boundaries.
Run focused state, boundary, accessibility and integration checks for affected behavior.
